description.main: The British volume of Hedi Slimane's four-part Anthology of a Decade (JRP|Ringier, 2011), collecting black-and-white photographs made in the UK between 2005 and 2010. Fans at gigs, the British Youth series and portraits of Pete Doherty, Amy Winehouse, Kate Moss, Arctic Monkeys and The Libertines fill its 160 pages.
description.extended:
The British volume of Hedi Slimane's four-part Anthology of a Decade, collecting the black-and-white photographs he made in the UK between 2005 and 2010, when the London guitar-band scene was the main subject of his camera.

JRP|Ringier published Anthology of a Decade in 2011 as four slipcased softcover volumes, one per territory, edited by Lionel Bovier in an edition of 1,000 and sold singly from 2012. The UK book runs to 160 pages with 198 duotone plates. It includes crowd pictures of fans at gigs, images from Slimane's British Youth series and portraits of James Jagger, Pete Doherty, Amy Winehouse, Kate Moss and Miles Kane, with band portraits of Arctic Monkeys, Test Icicles, The Paddingtons, The Libertines, These New Puritans and The Kills. Two still lifes bracket the music, Keith Richards's guitar collection and the gravestone of William Blake. The cover sets the Union flag in black and grey on the plain grey board used across the set.

Slimane (b. 1968, Paris) had already published London Birth of a Cult with Steidl in 2005, built around Pete Doherty and The Libertines. This volume carries that work across the rest of the decade. The narrow Dior Homme silhouette he was designing in the same years was cut for, and drawn from, the musicians photographed here.
description.artist_bio: Hedi Slimane (b. 1968, Paris) was menswear director at Yves Saint Laurent Rive Gauche (1997-2000), creative director of Dior Homme (2000-2007), Yves Saint Laurent (2012-2016) and Celine (2018-2024), and has run a photography practice throughout, with books including Berlin (Steidl/7L, 2003), Stage (Steidl/7L, 2004), London Birth of a Cult (Steidl, 2005) and Interzone (Purple Books, 2005).

notes: Shelf: Fashion. Volume UK of the four-volume Anthology of a Decade (JRP|Ringier, 2011), the others being US (9783037642214), FR (9783037642238) and DE RU (9783037642245). Also issued as a slipcased set of all four, ISBN 9783037641156 (724 pages). Volumes sold separately from 2012. Listed by JRP|Ringier and D.A.P. as UK; cover reads UK.

research_log.notes: Publisher page and D.A.P. agree on ISBN, pages, 232 x 290 mm, softcover, edition of 1,000, editor Lionel Bovier. Image count from the publisher (198 b/w); D.A.P. gives a slightly different count for the US and UK volumes. Year: the set was issued April 2011 (JRP, Getty); JRP and D.A.P. date the single-volume release February/April 2012. Subtitle taken from the cover as printed (UK), not from the trade listing name (UK). OpenLibrary attaches Vince Aletti and Jon Savage as authors across these ISBNs, which no publisher or Getty record supports, so no essayists are recorded.
